sbe:messageSchema.description: Node-local replay control protocol between a ReplayerService and its co-located clients

sbe:message.name: ReplayRequest
sbe:message.description: A client asks its replayer for history: one segment of the recording chain from position 0 (cold start, segmentIndex >= 0), or the active recording from fromPosition (after a gap, segmentIndex < 0)

field.name: clientId
field.description: The client's id, unique among the replayer's co-located clients

field.name: requestId
field.description: Incremented on every send, including an unchanged resend, and echoed in the reply. The client ignores a reply whose requestId is not its current one (R-1): a resend supersedes the in-flight replay, so a reply to the earlier request may still be queued on the control stream

field.name: fromPosition
field.description: Position to resume the active recording from (SequencedEvent.position of the last in-order frame); read only when segmentIndex < 0

field.name: segmentIndex
field.description: < 0: resume the active recording at fromPosition. >= 0: replay that recording of the chain (one per leader tenure, oldest first) from position 0. A cold start walks 0, 1, 2, … de-duplicating on globalSeqNo until the chain is exhausted (R-2); globalSeqNo is contiguous across tenures

sbe:message.name: Replaying
sbe:message.description: The replayer started a replay. The client attaches to replaySessionId on stream 201, follows it until catchUpPosition, then switches to the live tap, de-duplicating on globalSeqNo

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

field.name: replaySessionId
field.description: Aeron replay session to attach to on stream 201 (Subscription.imageBySessionId), or NO_REPLAY_NEEDED (-1) when there is nothing to replay

field.name: catchUpPosition
field.description: Position at which the replay ends and the client switches to the live tap. The client detects completion by reaching it, not by image close: a bounded replay of an active recording does not close its image at the bound

field.name: recordingId
field.description: Recording the requested segment resolved to, or -1 when the chain is exhausted. NO_REPLAY_NEEDED with recordingId >= 0 means only that this segment is empty; with -1 it ends the walk (R-2). The replayer resolves the chain on every request and may drop a stale span, so a client that gets a different recordingId for the same segmentIndex restarts the walk from segment 0 (R-3)

sbe:message.name: ReplayPending
sbe:message.description: All MAX_CONCURRENT_REPLAYS slots are busy. The client waits at its gap, without advancing past it, until a later Replaying arrives

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the request this answers (R-1)

sbe:message.name: ReplayComplete
sbe:message.description: The client has caught up and switched to the live tap; the replayer frees its slot now rather than at the idle timeout. Sent after a gap resume. A cold-start walk does not send it: each segment request supersedes, and frees, the previous slot

sbe:message.name: ReplayHeartbeat
sbe:message.description: Sent about every 500 ms while the client's replay image is running; resets the slot's idle timeout (R-4). A replay has no time limit, so without this a long replay would lose its slot. A client that dies stops sending, and its slot is reclaimed

sbe:message.name: ReplayUnavailable
sbe:message.description: This node cannot serve history for the replayer's lifetime: at start-up its oldest tap recording did not reach globalSeqNo 1 (deleted, corrupted or partially restored). Unlike ReplayPending, this is permanent. Refusing keeps the fault in the replayer; serving the replay would make every client fail its own check that history starts at 1

field.name: requestId
field.description: The requestId of the refused request (R-1)
